svg.data-optics-qsfp28: datasheet: each 100G QSFP28 port takes 1 x 100 GbE or breaks out to 2 x 50G, 4 x 25G or 4 x 10G. The datasheet's transceiver list names the modules and cables it is qualified with; more are referred to the vendor's site.

g.data-description: the 1PPS timing input - a single coaxial jack beside the system lamps. THE DATASHEET CALLS IT AN SMA; the drawings put it at about 6 mm, which is SMB scale, and common/smb-jack@1 is seated on that basis. It states no group media because coax is not a pluggable cage and L40's optics question does not apply to it.
g.title: pps-in

g.data-description: the thirty-two QSFP28 ports, in eight blocks of four - two columns of two - numbering down each column from 1 at the top left to 32 at the bottom right.
